method.initial_screening: All ten groups in equal proportions; current initial advertisements; P10 ranks fresh candidates with its submitted ad-cost rule and actual list cap; true scores are used only for offline evaluation.
method.screening_weighting: Equal weights per initial environment and seed; average within-run P10 individuals first.
method.rank_coverage: P10 and P8 have one exotic half-half opponent; other groups have two. Shared-roster rankings omit half-half_sample.
limitations: Current initial advertisements are reconstructed, not recorded original advertisements.
Initial shortlist enrichment does not measure the causal effect on final marriage outcomes.
Common-roster pooled results still weight seats, including different relative weights of equal and solo+random populations.
Only three seeds and a coarse environment grid; small rank gaps are descriptive.
